scope: General explanations for caregivers of babies aged 0–24 months in the Kenya-focused application. The separately checked routine timing overview is documented in vaccine-schedule-learning-source-review.json; neither area makes individual eligibility or catch-up decisions.
review_kind: Publisher pages checked for the limited claims below; this is source checking, not pediatric or clinical approval.

supports: Recommended vaccines together and combination vaccines
OPV and IPV expansions and polio prevention

sources.qualification: Other five-antigen combinations exist internationally. This card describes the combination already used in the Kenya-focused education service; it does not identify a product from a photograph or assign it to a child.
The July 2025 campaign dates and eligibility are not displayed as a current campaign or individualized schedule.

supports: Typhoid prevention and contaminated food or water transmission
RTS,S and R21 protection against P. falciparum
sources.qualification: No country or county eligibility map, dose timing, product assignment or comparative effectiveness claim is made.

supports: Vaccine prevention of mosquito-borne yellow fever
No evidence of a vaccine-autism link
Temporary soreness or mild fever and rare serious effects
sources.qualification: The effects card cannot evaluate a symptom or attribute causation; no medication advice or reassurance about an individual baby is included.

performance: Content and styles are dynamically imported only on opening. No application requests are made by the education module; Open in new chat prepares a fresh conversation, and questions use the existing checked coaching flow only after Send. Source links open publisher pages only when selected.
limitations: Source checking does not establish clinical validation or guarantee safety.
No booklet OCR, vaccine tracking, reminders or record inference is included.
No global latency guarantee is inferred from code splitting or mocked workflow tests.
